dashboardDesc: Your people, assets, and priorities — all in one place.
employeesDesc: Manage your team and keep employee documents up to date.
payrollDesc: Review earnings and deductions, then export a payroll summary.
custodyDesc: Track employee assignments and the status of every asset.
clearanceDesc: Review employee leave and custody before issuing clearance.
localNote: Demo data is stored locally and is not synced across devices.
storageError: Saved data could not be loaded or changes could not be saved. Storage may be full or data invalid. Keep this page open; unreadable saved data was not replaced.
logoutDemo: This is a demo account; there is no authenticated session to sign out of.
allStatuses: All records, including returned and lost
urgentDesc: Documents due for renewal or follow-up
pendingDesc: Custody to settle before completing clearance
name: Employee name
searchEmployees: Search name, ID, or job title…
saveError: Could not save. Review the fields and try again.
invalid: Enter a valid value within the allowed range
nameError: Enter a name between 2 and 100 characters
idNationalityError: Saudi IDs start with 1; non-Saudi IDs start with 2
ibanError: IBAN must start with SA followed by 22 digits
unsafe: Do not use HTML delimiters or control characters
payrollNotice: Demo calculation: 9.75% of basic + housing for Saudis, 0 for others, regardless of stored rate. This is not an approved Mudad or WPS file.
missingIban: Some employees have no IBAN. Review their details before using the summary.
currentSnapshot: The summary reflects current data, not historical payroll.
confirmLost: Mark this asset lost? This action cannot be reversed in this demo.
noAssignable: No employees are available for a new assignment
clearanceEmpty: Select an employee to review clearance
leaveNote: For review only; leave days do not block issuance in this demo.
clearanceBlocked: Clearance is blocked by assigned or lost custody. Settle these records first.
clearanceReady: All custody is settled. This employee is eligible for demo clearance.
issuedNote: Issuance is saved locally and cannot be repeated.
clearanceDemo: Demo review and issuance; not an approved legal document.
phoneError: Enter a Saudi mobile as 05xxxxxxxx or +9665xxxxxxxx
